existing_implementation.argmax_and_gradient: Vectorized gather/sum over the complete compatible wrong domain; detached argmax with exact ties resolved by first row-major coordinates. Recompute the chosen wrong score with its gradient and retain gold score gradient.
existing_implementation.combination: main + 0.25*mean_actor_hinge when enabled; return main unchanged when disabled.
existing_implementation.diagnostic_custody: Policy, objective diagnostics and completed-update trace validators bind coefficient 0.25, margin 1, source/IDs, domain hash, detached choice, hinge/total scalar and applied switch. Coefficient is hardcoded in both arithmetic and validators.
existing_implementation.empty_domain: Differentiable zero on valid actor logits; no max over an empty domain.
existing_implementation.inference_unchanged: The training filter precedes argmax; inference still retains topK candidates before compatibility. Existing code explicitly does not guarantee inference candidate coverage.
existing_implementation.negative_domain: Complete row-major valid source-token spans left<=right, excluding exact gold actor AND every span overlapping any present gold nonactor facet.

policy.actor_ranking_enabled: Explicit boolean switch; existing targeted policy supports both False and True.
policy.row_mean: All batch rows including differentiable zero for empty negative domains.

existing_implementation.training_authority: Gold nonactor compatibility is teacher-forced training-only, using authenticated training labels. It is not predictive compatibility, held-out gold or legal proof.

proposal_differences.effect: At the same hinge scalar this is four times the existing auxiliary contribution; it is an intentional objective change, not reuse of the closed existing coefficient.
proposal_differences.required_for_lambda1: Version and qualify the closed policy, arithmetic, objective diagnostics and traces together; update source controls. Do not change the scalar after validation or label coefficient 1 as 0.25.

proposal_differences.effect: The proposed wording includes nonactor-overlapping candidates that the existing hinge intentionally removes. This changes the negative-selection objective and cannot be treated as the same method.
proposal_differences.existing: Exclude spans overlapping present gold nonactor facets.
proposal_differences.required_for_wider_domain: Explicitly version/predeclare the domain, its source-coordinate authority and hashes, compatibility/filter-order interpretation, deterministic ties and controls.
proposal_differences.sealed_gaps_proposal: All valid actor spans except exact gold.

proposal_differences.effect: Even reuse 0.25 requires a new qualified outer protocol; silently toggling current checkpoint policy is rejected.
proposal_differences.minimal_reuse_extension: Add one explicitly named, closed actor ranking objective with ranking ON, retaining targeted coefficient 0.25/margin 1/domain unchanged and actor-only frozen parameter partition.
